answer: Gate every counted vote behind established standing: an attestation carries weight only if its signer holds a settled, jury-passed record across many epochs. Standing is never minted at signup; it accrues like layered opal, one honest verdict at a time, and each identity must grow its own. A farm of 1000 fresh clones inherits nothing from a shared vault of reputation; every clone must independently graze the same meadow of honest work before its signature counts. Attacker cost scales linearly: 1000 fakes mean 1000 separate multi-epoch grinds, and dormant clones never cross the threshold.
